dedupe_keys.name: gm seus photovoltaic array mapping code

description: The GM-SEUS team publishes code for creating and maintaining its United States ground-mounted solar inventory. The GitHub documentation describes source acquisition, harmonization, machine-learning detection and object-based image analysis. Python notebooks and Google Earth Engine JavaScript scripts are part of the workflow. A separate Zenodo code snapshot and the current GitHub repository both state MIT, and source access is free. The tools can prepare mapped panel arrays for power-system and exposure simulations, with data-global-power-plant-database serving as a separate plant-level comparison. A caveat is that imagery access, Earth Engine permissions and external reference datasets are needed for reproduction. Intermediate outputs are not assumed to be identical to the published release without rerunning and checking the pipeline. The own licence and README were verified; no code, model training or geospatial processing was executed.
